cases.sentence: ___ ее лица было холодное и неприязненное.
cases.translation: The expression on her face was cold and hostile.
cases.explain: Выражение is the subject of было (was), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Выражение ее ___ было холодное и неприязненное.
cases.translation: The expression on her face was cold and hostile.
cases.explain: Лица depends on выражение (expression of...) as a possessive genitive with no preposition needed.

cases.sentence: Она услыхала порывистый звонок Вронского и поспешно утерла эти слезы, но села к ___ и развернула книгу.
cases.translation: She heard Vronsky's abrupt ring and hastily wiped away her tears, but sat down by the lamp and opened a book.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) governs the dative case, giving лампе.

cases.sentence: Она услыхала порывистый ___ Вронского и поспешно утерла эти слезы.
cases.translation: She heard Vronsky's abrupt ring and hastily wiped away her tears.
cases.explain: Звонок is the direct object of the transitive verb услыхала (heard); it is inanimate, so its accusative form matches the nominative: звонок.

cases.sentence: Для тебя вопрос, останешься ли ты ___ со мной, а для меня...
cases.translation: For you the question is whether you'll remain the victor over me, but for me...
cases.explain: Победителем is a predicate noun after остаться (to remain), a verb that governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Она не хотела борьбы, упрекала его за то, что он хотел бороться, но невольно сама становилась в ___ борьбы.
cases.translation: She did not want a struggle and reproached him for wanting to fight, but she herself was involuntarily taking up a position of struggle.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case, giving положении.

reading.ru: Проводив гостей, Анна, не садясь, стала ходить взад и вперед по комнате.
reading.question: What did Anna do right after seeing off her guests?
options: She began pacing back and forth around the room
She wrote a letter to Vronsky
reading.correct: She began pacing back and forth around the room
reading.explain: The text says that, without sitting down, she began walking back and forth about the room.

reading.ru: Несмотря на резкое различие с точки зрения мужчин между Вронским и Левиным, она как женщина видела в них то самое общее, за что и Китти полюбила и Вронского, и Левина.
reading.question: What did Anna sense she had in common with both Vronsky and Levin, as a woman?
options: Something general that had also made Kitty fall in love with both of them
reading.correct: Something general that had also made Kitty fall in love with both of them
reading.explain: Despite the men's obvious differences, she saw in them that same general quality for which Kitty had loved both Vronsky and Levin.

reading.ru: Одна и одна мысль неотвязно в разных видах преследовала ее.
reading.question: What preoccupied Anna after Levin left?
options: One persistent thought kept pursuing her in various forms
She thought about returning to St. Petersburg
reading.correct: One persistent thought kept pursuing her in various forms
reading.explain: The text says one single thought relentlessly pursued her in various guises.

reading.ru: Он велел сказать со Стивой, что не может оставить Яшвина и должен следить за его игрой.
reading.question: What excuse did Vronsky send for staying out?
options: That he could not leave Yashvin and had to watch over his gambling
That he had urgent business at his club
That his horse had gone lame
That he was meeting with Stiva about finances
reading.correct: That he could not leave Yashvin and had to watch over his gambling
reading.explain: He sent word through Stiva that he could not leave Yashvin and had to watch his play.

reading.question: How did Anna describe getting an answer to her situation?
reading.explain: She reflects, "Again there is no answer."

reading.ru: Она услыхала порывистый звонок Вронского и поспешно утерла эти слезы.
reading.question: What did Anna do when she heard Vronsky's ring at the door?
options: She hastily wiped away her tears
She ran to greet him at the door
She sent the servant to answer
reading.correct: She hastily wiped away her tears
reading.explain: On hearing his abrupt ring she hastily wiped away her tears.

reading.ru: Она не хотела борьбы, упрекала его за то, что он хотел бороться, но невольно сама становилась в положении борьбы».
reading.question: Even though Anna resented struggle, what happened despite herself?
options: She found herself unwittingly taking up a position of struggle
She fell asleep before he arrived
reading.correct: She found herself unwittingly taking up a position of struggle
reading.explain: The text says that despite not wanting a fight, she involuntarily found herself in a position of struggle.

reading.ru: Он совсем было уж поехал, но вернулся опять и теперь в проигрыше».
reading.question: Why had Vronsky stayed out, according to Anna's accusation?
options: He had said he would stay to take Yashvin away, but then abandoned him anyway
He had a secret meeting with Kitty
He was avoiding Anna on purpose
He had lost track of time
reading.correct: He had said he would stay to take Yashvin away, but then abandoned him anyway
reading.explain: Anna points out that he said he'd stay to take Yashvin away, yet he left him after all.

reading.ru: Выражение ее лица было холодное и неприязненное.
reading.question: How is the expression on Anna's face described when she confronts Vronsky?
reading.explain: The text states the expression of her face was cold and hostile.

reading.ru: Она была рада этому вызову к нежности.
reading.question: How did Anna feel about Vronsky's gesture of opening his hand to her?
options: She was glad of this invitation to tenderness
reading.correct: She was glad of this invitation to tenderness
reading.explain: The text says she was glad of this appeal to tenderness.

reading.ru: Рука его закрылась, он отклонился, и лицо его приняло еще более, чем прежде, упорное выражение.
reading.question: What expression came over Vronsky's face during their quarrel?
reading.explain: His face took on, even more than before, an obstinate expression.

reading.ru: Он спросил ужинать и стал рассказывать ей подробности бегов.
reading.question: What did Vronsky do after the tense conversation?
options: He asked for supper and began telling her about the races
He apologized and went to bed
reading.correct: He asked for supper and began telling her about the races
reading.explain: He asked for supper and began telling her the details of the races.

reading.ru: А она чувствовала, что рядом с любовью, которая связывала их, установился между ними злой дух какой-то борьбы, которого она не могла изгнать ни из его, ни еще менее из своего сердца.
reading.question: What did Anna come to feel was now present between her and Vronsky alongside their love?
options: An evil spirit of some kind of struggle
reading.correct: An evil spirit of some kind of struggle
reading.explain: She felt that alongside the love that bound them, some evil spirit of struggle had settled between them, one she could not banish from either heart.
